# Gold Construction Protocol

1. Freeze source unit and hash it.
2. Gold Builder A receives source only.
3. Gold Builder B receives source only and cannot see A.
4. Run deterministic literal inventories where applicable.
5. Build A/B disagreement set.
6. Gold Adjudicator C receives source plus disagreement set, not model reputations.
7. Mechanically validate evidence/hashes/schema.
8. Freeze Reference v1.
9. Reveal historical SOL/Kimi/Gemini/etc outputs only now.
10. Historical-only candidate propositions become challenges, not automatic gold.
11. Adjudicate challenges against source.
12. Freeze Reference v2.
13. Gold builders are not scored against units they authored.
